191718.description:
Flum has been chosen by God to be in the hero's party despite having stats of zero across the board. All she has is the "Reversal" ability that she still doesn't fully understand. Predictably, she proves useless in battle, but she refuses to give up and continues to do all she can for the party. Her partymate Jean, a genius and renowned sage, picks on her at every opportunity and eventually sells her off into slavery. Even as a slave, she's treated as incompetent and persecuted, and ultimately thrown to monsters as bait for her master's entertainment. Flum is left with two options: take up the cursed sword that inevitably brings death to its wielder, or be eaten by monsters. The moment she chooses to fight back is when the "Reversal" of her life begins...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way-one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table.

Fan Lingxiao, a gifted spirit pet master, was ambushed in the A-level sect promotion competition and devoured by his own spirit, Kun. When he woke up, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named "Liu Fengmang" and imprisoned in the White Mansion. His sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was also in dire straits. In order to find out the truth about the backlash of the spirit Kun and revive the sect, Fan Lingxiao takes his existing spirit pets and embarks on a new adventure with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

191205.description:
Van, fourth son of a marquis, is just a toddler when he realizes he’s been reincarnated. Thanks to his literal lifetime of knowledge, he’s raised as a child prodigy—until his production magic manifests, and it’s the last thing his snooty mage family wants to see! His disappointed father banishes him to a podunk town on the verge of collapse, yet Van can only see the place’s potential. Can our hero’s bastion of battlements build a better life than battle magic ever could?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Prequel to Lupin the IIIrd the Movie: Fujimi no Ketsuzoku.

An airport bombing terror attack occurs in the frigid Roviet Union.
The unexpected suspect is Lupin III.
However, the "other Lupin" cornered by Zenigata claims his innocence.
Zenigata, a man of justice, finds himself confronted by the mysterious "fake Lupin."
A national conspiracy, the truth behind the bombing, and the intersection of two Lupins -- Zenigata's beliefs are put to the test.

The most rugged, passionate and melancholy buddy action movie in the series' history begins!

191967.description:
Meisuke "Nube" Nueno, a teacher at Doumori Elementary School and expert in the occult, finds it increasingly difficult to protect his students against dark forces. After one of his students is sent to a parallel world, Nube encounters an unusual spirit that sends him back in time to change one regretful event.

Although Nube manages to fix the situation, this succession of unlikely events suggests that a more serious menace may be threatening the peace of Doumori. To protect everyone he holds dear, Nube will have to overcome the demons of his past and uncover the nature of the looming supernatural danger.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

191452.description:
A young boy, Mario, is asked by his father, who works for a video game company, to become the GM. Although he is not keen, as a result of his analysis, he realizes that he can experience the same stimulation he received in the game in real life, and as an experiment, he sets his sights on a quiet girl named Koharu Takashina. Koharu wishes to become “a useful and gorgeous character,” which is the opposite of reality. However, the class she is given is that of a prostitute! After being raped by a rough man, her womb starts tingling, even though she is still a virgin in real life...

(Source: PinkPineapple, translated)

Kyouko brags about being scouted by her childhood friend Souji's favorite gravure idol. Souji gets angry and rejects her, but one day, he receives a video. It shows Kyouko in a risque swimsuit, taking on her first gravure shoot! In the video, she is at the mercy of the staff, and eventually she moans while saying Souji's name, being defiled by the hands of a stranger. What will Souji think of this...!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

191025.description:
A skilled carpenter/sculptor Jingoro, gets set up by his disciples and loses his right arm and his father in an "accident" during the reconstruction of the Edo Castle. A few decades later… Jingoro is continuing his journey of revenge with his partner “Sleeping Cat” and his weaponized prosthetic arm. People have come to call him Jingoro "Hidari," which means "left" in Japanese.

Jingoro defeats all the foes that has betrayed him, but he learns that Tokugawa Shogunate was behind the murderous event. He searches for clues on who was behind the whole set up, and fights with an army of mechanical soldiers along the way. Finally he confronts the mastermind behind all the killings, but first, he must save the city of Edo by stopping the Edo Castle, now turned into a gigantic weapon of mass destruction!

(Source: Official Website)

191492.description:
Since the shocking gravure photo shoot, Kyouko has become strangely seductive, and Souji has also changed... The two have become lovers, and one day Souji invites his friend Segawa to Kyouko's house for study purposes, but Souji sneaks out saying he has something to do. When they are alone, Kyouko actively invites Segawa out! Souji spies on Kyouko and Segawa getting wild with a hidden camera in the room...?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

191975.description: The mysterious young man Dafeng rescued Li Huamei, who was seriously ill after being plotted against. Dafeng wanted to go to Kyoto to find his senior sister and happened to be on the same road with Li Huamei. On the way, Li Huamei was shocked to find that her senior sister was the Queen Qin Zhao, and the Queen repeatedly sent assassins to kill her. In order to find out the reason, Dafeng and Li Huamei entrusted their lives to each other and fought against the enemy together. Disputes arose in the rivers and lakes, and the court struggles became more intense. The two were unknowingly involved in a treacherous conspiracy, and Dafeng was the key to solving all the mysteries...

191374.description:
Though Chichi the cat looks very cute, she has one goal: eradicate humanity and take over the world! She decides to recruit comrades to aid her in her quest, but it looks like world conquest won't be that easy?! Follow the adventures of Chichi the tyrant, Dunno the doggo who loves humans, and Kaiser Kang Taeshik, the hard-boiled wild hamster, as they face many hardships on their path to absolute dominion!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

191978.description:
Fifty years ago, the martial arts world was suddenly invaded by the “Hun Dun”. Murong Qiong established the Demon Sect to resist it, but they couldn’t manage to win despite arduous battles. The Divine Messenger Yi Zhihua descended and taught everyone the cultivation method of demonization, and they finally managed to defeat the Hun Dun. However, after the Divine Messenger left, the cultivation method went out of control as it spread in the martial arts world. Disappointed, Murong Qiong retired and his subordinate Yu Huabing seized the power, improved the cultivation method, and created an era of Punk True Qi, making the martial arts world thrive. But the price of prosperity was that all the cultivators became “Shang Gong fanatics”. Dongfang Sheng, harboring an idealistic and sincere aspiration, found Murong Qiong secluded in the Westward Restaurant. He hoped that Murong Qiong would assist in restoring the glory of the martial arts world.The comical story thus began...

(Source: BilibiliTV)
